SLIMEBOSS-MAGNIFICENT_BOWLER_HAT.title: Magnificent Bowler Hat
SLIMEBOSS-MAGNIFICENT_BOWLER_HAT.descrip: At the start of each combat, [gold]Split[/gold] into a [gold]Bruiser Slime[/gold].
SLIMEBOSS-MAGNIFICENT_BOWLER_HAT.flavor: He followed me home. Can I keep it?
SLIMEBOSS-VERY_MAGNIFICENT_BOWLER_HAT.de:
At the start of each combat, [gold]Split[/gold] into a [gold]Bruiser Slime[/gold].
[gold]Bruiser Slime[/gold] deals double damage.
SLIMEBOSS-VERY_MAGNIFICENT_BOWLER_HAT.fl: He followed me home, twice as intimidating this time.
SLIMEBOSS-GELATINOUS_CUBE.title: Gelatinous Cube
SLIMEBOSS-GELATINOUS_CUBE.description: [gold]Slimed[/gold] draws an additional card when played.
SLIMEBOSS-GELATINOUS_CUBE.flavor: It's not a cube. It's not gelatinous. It's just a slime with a legal team.
SLIMEBOSS-JEREMIAHS_BANNER.title: Jeremiah's Banner
SLIMEBOSS-JEREMIAHS_BANNER.description: Whenever you play a Status, [gold]Command[/gold] [gold]Bruiser Slime[/gold].
SLIMEBOSS-PAPER_HAT.title: Paper Hat
SLIMEBOSS-PAPER_HAT.description: [gold]Weakened[/gold] enemies take 25% more damage from Attacks and Slimes.
SLIMEBOSS-PAPER_HAT.flavor: Surprisingly, it does not actually reduce the damage you take.
SLIMEBOSS-PROTECTIVE_GEAR.title: Protective Gear
SLIMEBOSS-PROTECTIVE_GEAR.description: Whenever you add a card containing "Tackle" into your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]Adroit[/purple].
SLIMEBOSS-PROTECTIVE_GEAR.flavor: The best defense is a good offense.
SLIMEBOSS-SLIMED_TAIL.title: Slimed Tail
SLIMEBOSS-SLIMED_TAIL.flavor: A fake tail to trick enemies during combat, completely covered in slime.
SLIMEBOSS-SLIMY_CLEAVER.title: Slimy Cleaver
SLIMEBOSS-SLIMY_CLEAVER.description: The first [blue]{MaxUses}[/blue] [gold]Consume[/gold] effects you activate each combat don't remove a stack of [gold]Weak[/gold] from the enemy.
SLIMEBOSS-SLIMY_CLEAVER.flavor: Dull enough to bounce right off, sharp enough to still get the job done.
SLIMEBOSS-STONE_OF_NOMAKK.title: Stone of Nomakk
SLIMEBOSS-STONE_OF_NOMAKK.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{PotencyPower}[/blue] [gold]Potency[/gold].
SLIMEBOSS-STONE_OF_NOMAKK.flavor: When presented to one of your Goop Gang, it seems to make the blob dance.
SEA_GLASS.SLIMEBOSS-SLIME_BOSS.title: Legion Glass
